HEATING SEASON IN PASSAIC & BERGEN COUNTY
Old boilers and radiators are still everywhere in North Jersey. We work on all of it.

These are not new-construction houses. Our winters are spent on cast-iron radiators, tired boilers, forced-air furnaces and water heaters that always pick the worst week to quit. Whatever is behind your basement door, there is a good chance we have worked on one like it.

LIMITED TIME
Water Heater Replacement

40 gallon $1,600  ·  50 gallon $1,800

Standard tank water heaters. $100 off, limited time.

Water heater service →
AROUND THE CLOCK
No Heat, Day or Night

Boilers and furnaces do not wait for business hours. They quit on the coldest Sunday of the year. We take emergency heating calls at any hour across Woodland Park, Totowa, Little Falls, Fair Lawn, Hackensack, Wayne and Paramus.

Emergency heating repair →
BEFORE THE COLD
Get It Checked First

Small problems tend to show themselves in October and turn into no-heat calls in January. A seasonal check on the furnace, boiler or water heater is the simplest way to stay ahead of that.

Heating system maintenance →
Call (908) 528-0535

Talk to someone local in Woodland Park, not an answering service in another state.

HEATING SERVICES

Most of our winter happens in somebody’s basement.

The houses around Woodland Park are older than the equipment in them, and the equipment is usually older than it looks. This is the work the phone rings for once the cold sets in.

01
Furnace repair and installation
It lights, runs for a minute, then shuts itself down. Or it never lights at all. Ignition, blower, control board: that is usually where it ends up.
Furnace repair
02
Boilers, gas and oil
Pressure dropping overnight, a circulator that stopped turning, one zone cold while the rest of the house is perfectly fine.
Boiler service
03
Radiators and baseboard
Cold at the top, warm at the bottom, and nobody has bled them in years. Old cast iron is still some of the best heat in these houses when it is working.
Radiator service
04
Water heaters
No hot water is its own kind of emergency. We repair them where that makes sense and swap the tank where it does not.
Water heaters
05
No heat, right now
Nights, weekends, and the week between Christmas and New Year. Cold houses do not wait for business hours.
Emergency heating
06
Before the cold, not after
Seasonal checks on furnaces, boilers and water heaters, done while it is still mild enough to wait on a part if one is needed.
Seasonal maintenance

Not a heating problem? We handle air conditioning, heat pumps and ductless mini splits the rest of the year.

HOW IT WORKS

No heat is stressful. The call does not have to be.

Here is exactly what happens from the moment you reach us, so there are no surprises on the day.

01
Tell us what is happening

What is going on, and how long it has been going on. The more you can tell us on the phone, the better prepared the technician is when he pulls up.

02
We find a time that works

Often the same day, depending on our schedule and yours. No heat in the middle of winter goes to the front of the line.

03
You see the price before we start

We explain our service call fee, diagnose the problem properly, and give you an estimate. Nothing gets done until you have agreed to the number.

04
We do the job and clean up

Shoe covers and drop cloths, the work done properly, and a straight answer on what we fixed and what to keep an eye on.

Bigger job? There is financing.

A new furnace or boiler is a real expense. We offer financing on installations, and on qualifying high-efficiency equipment we file the New Jersey Clean Energy Program rebate paperwork for you. We will go through both during your free in-home estimate.

Book a free estimate

mainEntity.name: Do you do residential and commercial HVAC services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We specialize in residential and light commercial HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance in Woodland Park, NJ and nearby towns. See our Commercial HVAC Installation and Repair page for full details on commercial service.
Yes. We provide 24/7 emergency heating and cooling repair, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

mainEntity.name: What are signs my boiler needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strange noises, water leaks, uneven heating, higher energy bills, or frequent cycling are all common signs your boiler needs repair.

mainEntity.name: How long does a boiler last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most boilers last 15–20 years with regular maintenance. If your system is older and breaking down often, it may be time for replacement.

mainEntity.name: When should I replace my furnace?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your furnace is over 15 years old, needs frequent repairs, or no longer heats your home evenly, replacement may save money long-term.

mainEntity.name: Do you service all furnace brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our technicians repair and install most major furnace brands, including gas and high-efficiency models.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a new water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your water heater is leaking, producing rusty water, or no longer delivering enough hot water, it may be time for replacement.

mainEntity.name: How often should a water heater be serviced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Annual inspections and flushing can extend its lifespan and improve efficiency.
Yes. We offer seasonal maintenance to keep your HVAC, boiler, and water heater systems safe, efficient, and reliable.
We proudly serve Woodland Park, Fair Lawn, Little Falls, Wayne, and surrounding New Jersey towns.

About M&S Technician
The M&S Difference

We take pride in delivering fast, honest, and reliable service. Our mission is simple: do the job right, treat customers with respect, and leave every home cleaner and more comfortable than we found it. When you call us, you’re getting more than a technician—you’re getting a partner who genuinely cares about your comfort and satisfaction.

CALL US
Why Homeowners Choose M&S Technician

We’re trusted by more than 250 happy clients across New Jersey who rely on us for dependable HVAC repairs, efficient installations, and same-day emergency service. Here’s what sets us apart:

Family-Owned and Operated

We’re not a franchise. We’re a local, family-run business that believes in building relationships through honest work and consistent results. You can count on us to answer the phone, show up on time, and treat your home like our own.

Over 12 Years of Experience

With 12+ years of experience, we’ve seen and fixed it all—from boiler failures to complex heat pump installations. Our technicians are fully certified, insured, and trained to handle every HVAC challenge safely and efficiently.

Fast, Reliable Service

When your heating or cooling system goes down, every hour counts. That’s why we focus on getting jobs done quickly without cutting corners. We come prepared with the right tools, parts, and expertise to restore your comfort fast.

Satisfaction Guaranteed

We don’t leave until you’re 100% satisfied. Our goal is simple—to leave a smile on your face when the job’s done. We stand behind our work with performance guarantees and transparent communication from start to finish.

Our Services

We specialize in complete residential and commercial HVAC solutions, including:
